title: Generic algebra embedding for finite etale open covers
statement: Let $X$ be an integral scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme, and $P\to U$ a finite etale morphism [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-etale-morphism]. Let $V\subseteq X$ be a nonempty affine open with $A=\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_X)$ and $K=\operatorname{Frac}(A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-sc-function-field]. Put $f:P\to X$ for the composite and $B=\Gamma(f^{-1}V,\mathcal O_P)$ with its structural $A$-algebra structure. There exists a commutative finite etale $K$-algebra $D$ and an injective $A$-algebra homomorphism $B\to D$, where the $A$-algebra structure on $D$ is induced through $A\to K$. The open $U$, the cover, and the generic algebra may be empty or zero.

source.place: Tags 02GL (lemma-etale-over-field) and 081I (flat base change of scheme-theoretic images); application to the generic-point map

proof.text: If U is empty then P is empty, B is the zero ring, and the zero K-algebra supplies an injective structural map. Otherwise U contains the generic point of the integral X. Identify the generic stalk on V with Frac(A), and let alpha:Spec K -> U be the induced generic map.

Form P_eta = P times_U Spec K and D = Gamma(P_eta,O). Base change preserves finiteness and etaleness, so P_eta is affine and D is finite etale over K. These are the standard Mathlib IsFinite pullback instances, Etale pullback instances and HasRingHomProperty affine dictionary.

The generic map alpha is quasi-compact: each inverse image of an open is empty or the one-point Spec K. Its image is dense, and its target U is reduced, so it is scheme-theoretically dominant. Apply flat base change of scheme-theoretic dominance to the flat P -> U. The resulting projection P_eta -> P is quasi-compact and scheme-theoretically dominant; its maps on all section rings are injective. Use Mathlib IsSchemeTheoreticallyDominant.of_isPullback and Scheme.Hom.app_injective.

Since V contains the generic point, the inverse image of f^{-1}V in P_eta is all of P_eta. Composing the injective section map with this open-equality isomorphism gives B -> D. Naturality of section maps in the pullback square and the generic-stalk/fraction-field identification give its A-algebra compatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finiteEtale_open_generic_algebra {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral X]
    (U : X.Opens) (P : U.toScheme.FiniteEtale) (V : X.Opens) [Nonempty V]
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) Γ(P.obj.left, (P.obj.hom ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
      ((P.obj.hom ≫ U.ι).app V).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ (D : Type u) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra (FractionRing Γ(X, V)) D),
      Module.Finite (FractionRing Γ(X, V)) D ∧
      Algebra.FormallyEtale (FractionRing Γ(X, V)) D ∧
      letI : Algebra Γ(X, V) D :=
        Algebra.compHom D (algebraMap Γ(X, V) (FractionRing Γ(X, V)))
      ∃ e : Γ(P.obj.left, (P.obj.hom ≫ U.ι) ⁻¹ᵁ V) →ₐ[Γ(X, V)] D,
        Function.Injective e
